title: Missing #[non_exhaustive] on public structs in uuencoding crate
description: BlockMetadata, DecodedBlock, and ScannedBlock in uuencoding/src/lib.rs are all-pub-field structs with no #[non_exhaustive] attribute. Callers can construct them with struct literals. These are output types from decode() and scan() — callers should never need to construct them. What goes wrong: adding any field (e.g. to expose additional decode statistics or metadata) is a breaking change without #[non_exhaustive]. All three need the attribute added.
